issue.title: bob ref create Markdown PDFs repeat the H1 as section 1 and double-number manually numbered headings
issue.description:
`bob ref create <report>.md` runs pandoc with `--toc --number-sections` and also passes the
first H1 as `--metadata title=...` (create.rs `render_temp_pdf`). Two layout defects follow
in most rendered research/chat PDFs:

1. **H1 rendered twice and every section under "1".** The H1 that became the title is still
   a level-1 section, so the title block shows the title and section 1 repeats it. Every real
   section is numbered `1.x` (TOC: `1 Auto-advancing…`, `1.1 Bottom line`, …). Documents with
   no H1 get `0.x` numbers instead (`0.1 Overview`).
2. **Double numbering.** Agent-written headings that carry their own numbers (`## 1. Evidence`)
   get pandoc's number too: TOC `1.2 1. Evidence`.

Measured on 2026-10-07 over the 291 PDFs in `~/bob/lib/chat` (pdftotext of the TOC pages):
239/291 have `1.1`-style sections; 147/291 show double numbering (for example
`acp_provider_design.pdf: 1.1 1. Bottom line`, `agent_catalog_pane.pdf: 1.2 1. Evidence`).

Possible fixes (choose in implementation): `--shift-heading-level-by=-1` when the document's
only H1 is its title (pandoc then promotes it to the title), and skip `--number-sections`
(or strip the manual prefix) when headings are already numbered. Keep heading ids stable:
GitHub-style anchors to numbered headings (`#1-evidence`) already fail to resolve under
pandoc's default ids. The backlinks research (research:202610/ref_create_pdf_backlinks__cld.md)
proposes aliasing those, so coordinate if both land.

task_type_fields.impact: Every rendered research report Bryan reads in Highlights: 239/291 chat PDFs number all sections 1.x and repeat the title; 147/291 are double-numbered.
task_type_fields.repro: Render a report whose only H1 is its title and whose sections are '## 1. Summary', '## 2. Details': bob ref create report.md -o /tmp/r.pdf; pdftotext -l 1 -layout /tmp/r.pdf - shows the title twice and TOC lines '1.1 1. Summary', '1.2 2. Details'.

issue.creation_reason: Found while surveying rendered research PDFs for the ref-create backlinks research: most PDFs in the library show duplicated titles and 1.x or double section numbers, which hurts readability of every research report.
